import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p = params
    return (p[0] + p[1]*t + p[2]*t**2 + p[3]*t**3
            + p[4]*v + p[5]*v**2 + p[6]*v**3 + p[7]*np.tanh(v)
            + p[8]*x + p[9]*x**2
            + 0*x**3)
